target: Quero que ele leia esse livro.
english: I want him to read this book.
tip: Quero que forces the subjunctive: the verb becomes leia, not lê. Wanting someone else to act triggers this mood. Quero que ele leia esse livro.

target: A gente se preocupa demais com bobagem.
english: We worry too much about silly things.
tip: Preocupar-se pairs with com for what worries you. A gente se preocupa demais com bobagem = we worry too much over silly things.

target: Ela se maquiou rapidinho antes de sair.
english: She put on makeup quickly before leaving.
tip: rapidinho is the diminutive of rápido used as an adverb, meaning 'really quickly'.

target: Ele nos deu a melhor mesa do restaurante.
english: He gave us the best table at the restaurant.
tip: 'Melhor' (better/best) is the irregular comparative of 'bom' – never say 'mais bom'.

target: Eu te entendo perfeitamente.
english: I understand you perfectly.
tip: In Brazilian Portuguese the object pronoun comes before the verb: te entendo, not entendo-te.

target: Lamento que você esteja doente.
english: I'm sorry you're sick.
tip: Lamento que (I'm sorry that) expresses feeling, so the verb goes subjunctive: esteja, not está.

target: Talvez eu troque de celular.
english: Maybe I'll switch phones.
tip: Talvez (maybe) signals doubt, so the verb takes the subjunctive: troque, not troco.

target: A gente nos comprometeu a ajudar.
english: We committed ourselves to helping.
tip: A gente means we but takes a singular verb: a gente comprometeu, just like ele comprometeu.

target: Eu vim por causa dela.
english: I came because of her.
tip: Por causa de means because of, marking the reason for something: por causa dela = because of her.

target: Para que serve esse aplicativo?
english: What is this app for?
tip: Servir para means to be used for; Para que serve...? asks what an object is for.

target: Ele me trouxe um café.
english: He brought me a coffee.
tip: Trouxe is the irregular past of trazer (to bring): ele trouxe, never ele trazeu.

target: Embora esteja sol, está frio.
english: Although it's sunny, it's cold.
tip: Embora (although) always takes the subjunctive: embora esteja sol, never embora está sol.

target: Eu optei por ficar em casa.
english: I opted to stay home.
tip: 'Optar por' means 'to opt for/choose.' Some verbs always take 'por': optar por, lutar por, pagar por.

target: Ela me ligou ontem à noite.
english: She called me last night.
tip: À noite means at night; the à is the preposition a merged with a, written with a crase accent.

target: Ele me mandou embora mais cedo.
english: He sent me home early.
tip: Mandar embora means to send away or dismiss; here embora means away, not although.

target: Eu te ligo quando chegar.
english: I'll call you when I arrive.
tip: Quando about a future event takes the future subjunctive: quando chegar = when I arrive.

target: Eu lhe agradeço de coração.
english: I thank you from the heart.
tip: Lhe is the indirect object pronoun meaning to him, to her, or to you: eu lhe agradeço.

target: Eu vou te devolver amanhã.
english: I'll return it to you tomorrow.
tip: With vou plus an infinitive, the pronoun sits between them: vou te devolver.

target: O pacote foi enviado por correio.
english: The package was sent by mail.
tip: Por marks the means or channel: enviado por correio = sent by mail.

target: Para onde vocês vão nas férias?
english: Where are you going on vacation?
tip: Movement needs para onde: para onde vão asks 'where to'. Plain onde only asks where something is.

target: Ele me deu uma dica ótima.
english: He gave me a great tip.
tip: Deu is the irregular past of dar (to give): ele deu, never ele darou.

target: Eu não o entendi muito bem.
english: I didn't understand him very well.
tip: A negative like não pulls the object pronoun before the verb: não o entendi = I didn't understand him.

target: Quero que todos contribuam com ideias.
english: I want everyone to contribute ideas.
tip: Quero que (I want that) forces the subjunctive: contribuam, not contribuem.

target: Esse presente é para a minha mãe.
english: This gift is for my mom.
tip: Para marks the recipient or beneficiary of something: para a minha mãe = for my mom.

target: Eu lhe asseguro que não há problema.
english: I assure you there's no problem.
tip: Há comes from haver and stays fixed for there is or there are: não há problema.

target: Vocês poderiam falar mais baixo, por favor?
english: Could you speak more quietly, please?
tip: The conditional poderiam softens a request to sound polite: poderiam falar = could you speak.

target: Eu vou para o Brasil mês que vem.
english: I'm going to Brazil next month.
tip: Some country names carry an article: o Brasil, so you go para o Brasil, not para Brasil.

target: Ele nos levou de carro até o aeroporto.
english: He drove us to the airport.
tip: De marks the means of transport: de carro = by car, like de ônibus or de avião.

target: Não há nada que eu possa fazer agora.
english: There's nothing I can do now.
tip: An antecedent like nada que (nothing that) triggers the subjunctive: nada que eu possa fazer.

target: Passamos por várias cidades durante a viagem.
english: We passed through several cities during the trip.
tip: 'Por' expresses movement through a place. 'Passar por' = to pass through. Think of 'por' as 'through/via.'
